title: Read independently authorized operational SLA state/provenance for a selected Command work item
goal: Integrate canonical CAP-CMD-105 bounded read-only operational SLA status, policy source/version and due/remaining evidence into existing owner-authorized six-view Work Queue selected-item Inspector without manufacturing policy calculations or Class-2 mutation.
invariants: Canonical owner CAP-CMD-105; work parent E10-CMD-105 epic; selected-list consumer CAP-CMD-101 and existing Command Incident/Task owner. Git parent PR #173 frozen HEAD 89a092bade8b2137732ac5da8583a1d321249549 is NOT engineering parent.
Same /command/work-queue six-view route; only selected current-page owner-authorized Incident/Task may invoke optional SLA source adapter.
SLA owner MUST independently authorize policy source/engagement within host session tenant/environment; object CanRead is not SLA-policy permission.
Missing SLA policy is unknown, never healthy; do not invent thresholds, remaining duration, pause permission or contractual customers; supplied policy state is read-only with source/version/time.
OPEN-013 forbids Class-2 pause/restart/change; ADM tenant set never broadened; no second queue or new auth engine.
security_properties: SLA lookup only after current owner.CanRead and selected current-page row checks, never for denied/foreign/out-of-page items.
Host-provided tenant/environment/principal; client cannot supply policy source or SLA status.
Invalid or unavailable source claims abort selected response generically with no partial selected-row or policy disclosure; no item/sensitive SLA lookup for unselected pages.
No new runtime dependency or network listener; native HTML automatically escapes source strings.

migration.rationale: Optional selected-only host interface; historical Item, Row, Result when unselected and all six Work Queue views unchanged.

rollback.strategy: Remove optional SLA adapter and SelectedSLA field/render while retaining prior source-owned CAP-CMD-104 coordination dimensions.
verification: All previous six views and cursor/selection tests remain green.

inputs: Full CAP-CMD-105 §§1–27, CAP-CMD-101 §§1–27, module README, Incident/Task canonical objects, tenant/permissions contracts and ADR-0008 accepted split operational SLA vs contractual customer projection.
Frozen parent PR #173 CI both SUCCESS at SHA 89a092bade8b2137732ac5da8583a1d321249549.
Existing queue exposes only owner-provided SLAAtRisk bool and CAP-CMD-104 SLA risk dimension, with no selected policy source/version or due time.
outputs: Optional host ReadAuthorizedSLA read-only projection of selected owner-authorized Incident/Task in SAME HTTP route and escaped native HTML.
Explicit SLA state, policy source/version, as-of time, optional due and source-owned remaining seconds; unknown on no provider, fail-closed on invalid/unavailable provider.
No policy calculation or user-selected SLA source, no Class-2 mutation, customer object, report/export or broader tenant visibility.
acceptance_tests: Current selected readable row returns source-authorized state and version/due/remaining with correct principal, tenant, environment and kind/id, zero extra list calls.
Absent adapter or nil SLA is unknown, no healthy or remaining invented.
Invalid/malformed/denied source fails closed and doesn't leak item/policy details; denied, foreign and off-page selection never causes SLA source call.

Exact GitHub SHA command-work-queue-runtime Go Linux/macOS/Windows and mandatory engineering-kernel unchanged security-critical 90% floor, architecture/deps/SAST/manifest checks verified before merge.

performance_budget.rationale: Exactly one extra optional source lookup ONLY for one selected visible and owner-authorized row; no other requests call the adapter, unchanged 5000 candidate/50-row bound.
metrics: At most one ReadAuthorizedSLA per valid selected request.
No extra owner.List/CanRead, no new traversal of saved views or linked object graph.

definition_of_ready: Parent E10-CMD-101F-SELECTION IMPLEMENTED; latest PR #173 parent HEAD workflow checks both SUCCESS, but remains DRAFT unmerged.
CAP-CMD-105 operational SLA read-only disclosure is Class 0; OPEN-013 affects only Class-2 mutations. ADR-0008 external contractual SLA remains source projection, not new Customer object.
One bounded context and optional first-party interface; no migration or external library.
definition_of_done: Publish first-party source-authorized selected-only read-only SLA and meaningful refusal/security tests with manifest, work graph and current state, preserving frozen parent SHA.
Check exact-head GitHub Actions including mandatory 90% security coverage, SAST, manifests; never declare whole CAP-CMD-105 accepted or production.
Material source-permission boundary warrants ONE independent read-only L2 after sufficiently stable verified delivery, no duplicates.
